bio: Don Tracy (born 1949 or 1950) is an American lawyer, politician, and business owner. A member of the Republican Party, Tracy served as acting and confirmed chair of the Illinois Gaming Board (2015–2019) as an appointee of then-Governor Bruce Rauner, and as chair of the Illinois Republican Party (2021–2024), succeeding Tim Schneider. He ran unsuccessfully as a candidate for Illinois Lieutenant Governor in 2010.
